head: Gemini gets a new sparkling look on Android phones
dek: Google is rolling out a new design for the Gemini overlay on Android, with glowing dots and a sparkle animation around the "Ask Gemini" box. It comes through the Google app, so it isn't limited to new Pixel phones.
details: After the animation, the edges of the text box look slightly shaded. The change is easier to see in dark mode than in light mode.
where: Android, rolling out through the Google app
means: If Gemini looks different when you open it, that's this update; it works the same way.
todo: Update the Google app in the Play Store. If the new look doesn't show, force-stop the Google app and open it again.
